title: 2026 Honolulu Century Ride
description: Hawaii's largest cycling event. Car-free sections of Kaiwi Coast, backroads of Waimānalo, and the windward coast. Thousands of riders.

title: Mauka Sunday Group Ride
description: Weekly Sunday community ride. All levels welcome. Pace groups form naturally. Coffee stop common.

title: HBL Sunday Morning Coffee Jam
description: Regular Sunday social ride + coffee. Great for newer riders and community.

title: Cycle the Summer at Sheridan Park
description: Keiki biking opportunities, hands-on bicycle repair clinic, and park cleanup. Family-friendly.

title: Mauka Weekday Evening Spin
description: Casual weekday evening ride. Good for after-work fitness and social miles.

title: OCC Coffee Jam / Small Group
description: Informal meetup coordinated via the Oahu Cycling Club Facebook group. Check the group for latest start location.
